key.name: window-controls-scope
key.description: Which focused windows get window controls in the top bar: all windows, maximized windows (fullscreen included) or fullscreen windows only. Titlebar button removal follows the same scope. Replaces show-window-controls-fullscreen-only.

key.name: window-controls-position
key.description: Which side of the top bar holds the window controls. 'system' follows the side of the window button layout set in GNOME.

key.name: remove-titlebar-buttons
key.description: While the panel shows window controls, hide the close, minimize and maximize buttons that GTK 3 and GTK 4 windows draw in their own titlebars. Uses GTK CSS in the user's gtk.css; the window button layout is not changed.
